content:
Blur将停用前端，Blend暂停新贷撮合，链上协议继续运行

NFT交易市场Blur通过官方账号宣布，其前端将于2026年11月12日弃用。消息虽短，信息量不小：这是NFT赛道曾经的最大赢家之一，在市场深度萎缩后做出的主动收缩。

Blur曾以零手续费、代币空投与面向专业交易者的工具著称，官网口径的累计总交易额约74亿美元、总用户约32.5万。据CoinGecko历史研究，2023年2月其凭空投攻势拿下约56.8%的NFT交易份额，超过OpenSea当时的36.5%；2023年3月单月交易量约14.3亿美元。但热度未能延续，据统计，到2026年3月单月交易量已不足700万美元，缩水超过99.5%。

核心事实层面，据ChainCatcher转述的官方公告，前端弃用安排仅适用于前端，Blur市场协议将继续在链上运行，BLUR代币继续控制协议费用开关。另据区块客报道，NFT借贷协议Blend将同步停止撮合新贷款，借款人需在期限前偿还债务，否则承担违约后果；官方表示期限过后将提供前端工具，协助用户从Blend提领资产。

理解此事的关键在于区分前端与协议。停用的是主要用户界面和运营入口，链上智能合约与治理功能仍在。换言之，Blur收缩的是运营与获客一侧，而非链上资产的终止。对仍在使用Blend的用户来说，重点是还款时限与提领流程，官方虽承诺提供工具，但具体执行细节与体验仍待观察。

从影响路径看：其一，消息公布后BLUR代币承压明显，据区块客援引市场快照统计，较2023年2月约5.02美元的历史高点累计回撤约99.7%。其二，专业交易者常用入口减少，NFT交易与借贷流动性可能进一步向聚合器和其他平台迁移，蓝筹系列的挂单深度或受影响。其三，生态连锁反应值得关注：Blur创办人Pacman推动的Layer2网络Blast近期亦宣布结束运营计划，Abstract也传出关闭消息，NFT金融化叙事整体承压。

编辑判断：从事实层面看，停用前端不等于全面关停，链上协议、费用开关与治理权仍保留，这是与彻底退出市场的本质区别。但从份额巅峰到交易量缩水逾99%，说明以代币奖励和低费率驱动的增长模式在投机需求退潮后难以持续经营。后续可关注三点：11月12日前Blend的还款与提领执行情况、是否有第三方前端承接流量，以及BLUR费用开关治理的下一步动向。上述推断部分是基于公开信息的合理延伸，具体请以官方后续公告为准。

content:
一、以太坊市场走势分析

二零二六年十月十三日，以太坊现货价格报二千五百一十九点三美元，过去二十四小时内下跌百分之零点八。盘中最低触及二千四百二十一点零七美元，随后反弹至二千五百三十四美元附近。以太坊的跌幅明显大于比特币，反映出山寨币市场整体承压的格局。

从资金流向数据来看，以太坊在底部区域出现了明显的机构抄底行为。当价格跌至二千四百二十一美元时，现货市场流入资金激增四千二百零三万美元，买方力量积极吸收卖盘压力，价格随后重新站上二十五小时指数移动平均线。此外，Interactive Brokers推出了以太坊质押服务，企业财团也累计增持了一万二千五百三十二枚以太坊，这些基本面利好为价格提供了底部支撑。

二、技术指标解读

小时级别技术指标显示，以太坊的RSI指标曾一度跌至八点三的极端超卖水平，随后出现 bullish MACD柱状图翻转，推动了日内的技术性反弹。五周期均线发出看多信号，但RSI十四周期指标仍偏空，显示短期动能存在矛盾。

综合指标方面，十五个因子中四个看多、十一个看空，与比特币的空头比例一致。但值得注意的是，以太坊的复合指标值为正零点八九，整体信号为看多，历史胜率为百分之七十五。这表明虽然多数因子偏空，但综合权重计算后以太坊的技术面略优于比特币。价格目前在二千五百三十美元附近面临阻力，MACD柱状图动能正在收缩，需要关注能否有效突破该位置。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊面临的市场压力主要来自机构资金的持续流出。现货以太坊ETF在过去一周净流出五点四二亿美元，十月十二日单日流出八千五百四十万美元，整个十月份累计流出接近七点八九亿美元。这种大规模的机构赎回对价格形成了持续的上方压力。

安全事件也加剧了市场的谨慎情绪。Ledger硬件钱包供应链攻击事件导致超过八千六百万美元的损失，涉及比特币、以太坊和TRON等多个链上资产，三百一十五个钱包受到影响。这一事件提高了投资者的风险意识，部分用户可能选择暂时离场观望。

积极因素方面，香港交易所迎来了Solana现货ETF上市，亚洲机构化进程持续推进。币安钱包也启动了代币化证券交易竞赛，推动链上证券生态的发展。这些利好长期来看有助于改善以太坊及整个加密市场的生态基本面。

热门代币方面，GNS当前报价零点四九一美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之三十四点五二。BAT报价零点一八二一美元，涨幅百分之二十点五二。S代币报价零点零六八七二美元，涨幅百分之十九点九九。

translatedData.subTitle:
The script for every market cycle is almost the same:
① Doubt: Prices have risen for a few days, but no one believes it. Everyone is calling it a dead-cat bounce and urging people to sell.
② Acceptance: Prices hit a new high, analysts turn bullish, and retail investors board the rally half-convinced.
③ Excitement: Prices keep surging, people in the group start showing off their gains, and you begin to fear missing out.
④ Euphoria: Everyone on social media is talking about crypto, taxi drivers are recommending coins, and leverage is soaring.
⑤ Denial: Prices start falling, and everyone says, “It’s a healthy correction—a chance to get in.”
⑥ Panic: Prices plunge continuously, and everyone is rushing to cut their losses—yet this is where the seeds of the next cycle are sown.

I used to think that a long/short ratio above 1 meant there were more long positions than short positions across the whole market. Then I realized the accounts ratio counts accounts: a small account and a whale each count as one. That’s a different thing from which side has more positions across the market—the total number of longs and shorts is always equal.
The long/short ratio is often treated as a sentiment indicator: when one side gets especially crowded, a price move against the majority can trigger a cascade of stop-losses.

title: ETH和Gas费：一条链的油钱是怎么回事
subTitle:
转账要交Gas费、mint个NFT要Gas费，这钱付给谁了？

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的
「油钱」。网络越堵，大家抢着执行，油价（Gas单价）越高。

【为什么和币价有关】行情火爆→链上交易暴增→Gas费飙升。所以老玩家
有个习惯：链上操作挑深夜或行情冷清的时候，同样的操作能省一半钱。

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，
挺有意思。

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What Are a Blockchain’s Fuel Costs?
translatedData.subTitle:
You pay gas fees to transfer funds or mint an NFT—but who gets that money?

【The basics】Ethereum is a computer shared by the whole world. Every operation (transferring funds, trading, running
a contract) uses computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who perform those computations for you.
“Fuel costs.” The more congested the network, the more people compete to get their transactions processed, and the higher the gas price (the price per unit of gas).

【Why it’s related to coin prices】A red-hot market → a surge in on-chain transactions → gas fees skyrocket. That’s why experienced users
have a habit: they do on-chain operations late at night or when the market is quiet. The same operation can cost half as much.

My view: ETH’s short-term recovery deserves recognition, but I won’t misrepresent a price rise as proof that institutional money has returned. Farside’s fund-by-fund table shows that on October 12, U.S. spot Ethereum funds saw combined net outflows of about $85.4 million. ETHA accounted for about $75.1 million in outflows, while Grayscale’s Ethereum Mini Trust (ETH) saw about $10.3 million in outflows; the table showed zero for the other funds that day. Based on the reported figures in the table, ETHA accounted for about 88% of that day’s net outflows, indicating that the pressure was concentrated in one product rather than redemptions occurring across all funds. For October 13, the fields are still dashes and the automatically calculated total currently shows 0.0. That means the figures have not yet been reported; it cannot be used to claim “zero outflows” or that flows have turned positive today.

The impact of these figures on ETH’s trajectory has two layers. Net fund redemptions may be transmitted to the ETH spot market through the creation and redemption process involving authorized participants and the funds, but someone selling fund shares on the secondary market does not mean an equivalent amount of ETH is dumped at the exact same moment. BlackRock’s ETHA prospectus explains that shares are created and redeemed in baskets by authorized participants, and that cash creations and redemptions involve the trust handling purchases and sales of ether. The specific timing, counterparties, and market impact costs cannot be inferred from Farside’s single aggregate figure. Conversely, even if ETH rebounds on the next trading day, that does not mean the redemption data were false. My assessment is that flows still need to be confirmed by the next complete table; ETH’s ability to absorb the earlier outflows matters more than whether a single day’s figure is red or green.

At 22:39 Beijing time, the latest trade in ETH/USD on Kraken was around $2,518.75, above the opening price of $2,444.03 for the measurement window. The 24-hour low was $2,406.71 and the high was $2,535.22. In other words, the market has clearly recovered from its lows, but has not yet broken above the intraday high. This does not prove that fund flows drove the rebound; it may reflect a combination of spot buying, short covering, or a shift in overall risk appetite. I won’t invent a single explanation for the market. Next, I’m watching whether $2,535–$2,550 turns into support and whether the area around $2,460 holds. If the price falls back below $2,460 and newly reported fund data continue to show concentrated outflows, my view that the recovery will continue is invalidated. If the price breaks above $2,550 and holds on a retest, that would show demand has withstood a test from fund flows.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now and wouldn’t chase the move just because it has rebounded after a drop. I’d only consider a small spot long. I would enter with 2% of my total capital only if the hourly candle closes above $2,550, the price retests $2,535–$2,550 without breaking below it, and there is no new major security or regulatory negative news. The first target is $2,600; I’d reduce my position by half when it reaches that level. The target for the remainder is $2,660. I’d set the initial stop at $2,500 and close the entire position if it is hit. I’d also exit early if updated fund data show a significant increase in outflows while the price falls back below $2,535. If the price breaks below $2,460 first, I’d cancel the entire long setup rather than record an untriggered plan as a trade. For me, fund data and price action must confirm each other; I’d rather be a step late.

#ETH

title: USDT为什么能锚定1美元？稳定币的运转原理
subTitle:
玩合约离不开USDT，但很多朋友没想过它凭什么值1美元。

【原理】稳定币由发行方运营：你给它1美元，它发给你1个USDT，并把
美元（及等值资产）存进储备。市场上谁想把USDT换回美元，就向发行
方赎回。这套「申购-赎回」机制像锚一样，把价格钉在1美元附近。
价格偶尔偏离一点点（比如0.999），套利者马上搬砖抹平。

【要关心的风险】储备透明度。USDT定期公布储备报告（含美债等资产），
但历史上稳定币圈出过事——储备不够的稳定币脱锚崩掉，持有人血本
无归。所以：大额资金别长期躺在单一稳定币里，分散是免费的保险。

translatedData.title: Why Is USDT Pegged to $1? How Stablecoins Work
translatedData.subTitle:
It’s hard to trade futures without USDT, but many people haven’t thought about what makes it worth $1.

【How it works】A stablecoin is managed by its issuer: you give it $1, it gives you 1 USDT, and puts
dollars (and equivalent assets) into its reserves. Anyone in the market who wants to exchange USDT back for dollars can contact the issuer
redeem it from the issuer. This “issuance-redemption” mechanism acts like an anchor, keeping the price close to $1.
If the price occasionally deviates slightly (for example, to $0.999), arbitrageurs quickly trade to bring it back in line.

title: 交易心理 | 空仓也是一种仓位，而且是高手用得最多的那种
subTitle:
新手最大的误区：不持仓就等于没在交易。于是天天满仓进进出出，
手续费和波动把本金磨没了。

实际上，空仓是唯一一种「亏损为零」的仓位。看不懂的行情空仓，
多空打架的行情空仓，刚连错几笔之后空仓——这三个时刻省下来的钱，
比大部分交易赚的都多。

打猎的比喻都听腻了，但道理是真的：猎人大部分时间在等，扣扳机
只要一秒。手里有本金，机会来了你才有子弹。拿稳你的子弹。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Being flat is also a position—and the one experienced traders use most often
translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest misconception beginners have is that not holding a position means you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, constantly buying and selling,
until fees and market swings erode their capital away.

In fact, staying flat is the only position where your losses are zero. If you can’t read the market, stay flat.
When bulls and bears are battling, stay flat; after a string of losing trades, stay flat—the money you save in these situations
is more than most people make from trading.

You may be tired of the hunting metaphor, but it’s true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes only a second. Keep your capital ready, and you’ll have ammunition when an opportunity comes. Hold on to your ammunition.

Keep these points in mind about Gas fees:
1) Gas that has already been used is generally not refunded if a transaction fails, since validators did execute it.

Proposer-builder separation (PBS) means assigning “assembling transactions into a block” and “proposing and signing the block” to two different types of participants.
Building the most profitable block requires specialized computation and access to transaction sources. PBS allows ordinary validators to earn returns close to those of professional players without needing these capabilities.
For blocks produced through MEV-Boost, builders must use $ETH  to pay a bid to the validator proposing the block. Currently 2505.72.

Tomorrow evening (Beijing time, October 14 at 20:30), the U.S. Department of Labor will release September CPI. This is the final inflation report before the October 27–28 FOMC meeting, and the only high-impact global macro event this week.

Let’s start with what we know. August CPI was up 3.4% year over year and 0.4% month over month; core CPI was up 2.4% year over year and 0.3% month over month. Market expectations for September are notably divided: headline CPI is expected to rise to 3.6%–3.7% year over year and 0.5%–0.6% month over month, while core CPI is expected to hold at just 2.4%–2.5% year over year and 0.2% month over month. In other words, the market has already assumed that headline inflation will rebound, while core inflation will remain broadly unchanged.

The reason for the divide is clear: energy. U.S. retail gasoline prices hit a record high for September, with rising crude prices feeding directly into the energy component of headline CPI. Core CPI excludes food and energy, so it is largely unaffected by this disturbance. The key question this time, then, is whether the “scissors gap” between headline and core inflation will widen. A wider gap would suggest that the inflation rebound is being driven by an external energy shock rather than overheated domestic demand. A surprise rise in core CPI to above 0.3% month over month, however, would be a genuinely worrying signal.

The transmission chain is clear. Keep three links in mind:

First, a core CPI surprise to the upside → the market raises the odds of a rate hike at the FOMC meeting at the end of October. On September 16, the Fed had just raised rates to 3.75%–4.00%, its first hike this year. If core inflation continues to climb, the narrative of “consecutive tightening” will take hold.

Second, rising rate-hike expectations → a stronger U.S. Dollar Index and higher Treasury yields. Higher returns on dollar assets tighten global dollar liquidity accordingly—putting emerging-market currencies under pressure and weighing on risk-asset valuations.

Third, tighter liquidity → interest-free assets with the strongest risk-on characteristics, such as $BTC , are the first to be drained of capital. Conversely, if core inflation comes in below expectations, the dollar gets some breathing room and risk appetite recovers, creating a tailwind for $BTC  and $ETH . The logic works in reverse: crypto markets respond to the ease or tightness of dollar liquidity, not to whether the inflation number itself is high or low.

One easy trap to fall into: seeing headline inflation at 3.6% and panicking that “inflation is out of control.” If the headline figure is high but core inflation is unchanged, the market has likely already priced it in. What will really drive the market is whether monthly core CPI breaks above 0.3%.

In short: watch monthly core CPI tomorrow, and don’t let energy-driven noise in the headline figure throw you off. Risk appetite for $BTC  moves inversely to dollar liquidity, and the switch controlling how loose or tight that liquidity is lies in core inflation.

#BTC #ETH #Crypto

content:
明天晚上（北京时间 10 月 14 日 20:30），美国劳工部公布 9 月 CPI。这是 10 月 27–28 日 FOMC 议息前的最后一份通胀数据，也是本周全球宏观唯一的高影响级变量。

先把已知底牌摆出来。8 月 CPI 同比 3.4%、环比 0.4%，核心同比 2.4%、环比 0.3%。9 月市场预期出现明显分裂：整体同比预期升到 3.6%–3.7%，环比 0.5%–0.6%，而核心同比预期只稳在 2.4%–2.5%、环比 0.2%。也就是说，市场已经默认整体通胀要反弹，但核心通胀基本不动。

分裂的原因很具体：能源。9 月美国零售汽油均价创出当月历史新高，原油端的涨价直接灌进整体 CPI 的能源分项。核心 CPI 剔掉了食品和能源，所以基本不受这波扰动。因此这次数据真正的看点，是整体和核心的「剪刀差」会不会扩大——剪刀差扩大，说明通胀反弹的驱动力是外部能源冲击而非内需过热；核心若意外升到环比 0.3% 以上，才是真正烫手的信号。

传导链条很清晰，记住三个环节：

第一，核心超预期 → 市场把 10 月底 FOMC 加息概率往上打。9 月 16 日美联储刚把利率加到 3.75%–4.00%，是今年以来第一次加息，如果核心继续走高，「连续收紧」的叙事就接上了。

第二，加息预期升温 → 美元指数和美债收益率走强。美元资产收益率抬升，全球美元流动性相应收紧——新兴市场货币承压、风险资产估值被压制。

第三，流动性收紧 → $BTC 这类无息、高风险偏好属性最强的资产率先被抽血。反过来，若核心低于预期，美元松口气，风险偏好回补，对 $BTC 和 $ETH 就是顺风。逻辑是反着的：加密市场吃的是美元流动性的松紧，不是通胀数字本身的高低。

一个容易踩的坑：只看整体同比 3.6% 觉得「通胀失控」就恐慌。整体数字高但核心不动，市场多半已经定价完毕，真正主导行情的是核心环比有没有破 0.3%。

一句话：明天盯核心环比，别被整体数字的能源噪音带偏节奏。$BTC 的风险偏好跟美元流动性反向，而美元流动性松紧的开关，捏在核心通胀手里。

Why does this news matter?
A stronger dollar reflects risk aversion. With unrest in the Middle East and U.S. inflation not fully under control, these two potential flashpoints are pushing money toward perceived safe havens like the dollar. When analysts talk about the “line that ends the 18-year bull market,” they’re basically asking how far this dollar rebound can go. If it breaks above that line, a period of dollar strength could really be on the way. For crypto, the most direct logic is: a strong dollar = weak crypto.

Impact on the market
In the short term, a strong dollar puts pressure on BTC and ETH. Since crypto is priced in dollars, a stronger dollar naturally weighs on these assets. For example, ETH is currently at $2,560. If the dollar rises another 5%, ETH would be worth over $100 less in dollar terms. Even if its actual price hasn’t changed, it can feel like a drop when trading. However, the impact could be softened by ETF inflows. The Nasdaq has fallen sharply recently, and investors who don’t want to get wiped out in the stock market may turn to ETFs instead, which would be positive for crypto. So, a stronger dollar doesn’t necessarily mean crypto will crash—the key is how much money ETFs can attract.

📰 Is XRP’s 100 Billion Cap Set in Stone? The Foundation Finally Explains the Vulnerability

The XRP Ledger Foundation recently posted on social platform X to explain a security patch released two weeks ago. The Foundation emphasized that the total supply of XRP has always been fixed at 100 billion and has never changed. The so-called vulnerability was simply a way to bypass the rules for creating XRP, and the patch closed that backdoor—like a car with a speed limit of 120: the vulnerability made the dashboard display 180, and the fix was to repair the dashboard, not add a turbocharger. All ledger data is publicly accessible, and any newly created coins would inevitably be recorded. For XRP holders, this is reassuring news.

Why does this news matter?
This clarification directly dispels market rumors that XRP’s total supply was out of control. The Foundation characterized the technical vulnerability as a “rule bypass,” not a “system flaw,” anchoring XRP’s deflationary model once again in the underlying logic of the blockchain. This means:
1. XRP’s deflationary nature is intrinsic and cannot be changed
2. Any attempt to use a technical exploit to exceed the supply cap will be fixed
3. The Foundation’s efforts to distance itself from the supply issue may signal that future regulatory discussions will focus more on compliance than inflation risks

Compared with recent inflation controversies on other chains, such as adjustments to Solana’s tokenomics, XRP’s fixed supply highlights its distinctive advantage. At a deeper level, this marks a new phase in decentralized project governance, shifting from “features first” to “rules above all.”

Market impact
For XRP, the impact is a temporary psychological recovery. In the short term, bears may change their position because there is no mechanism to create new coins. But for BTC and ETH, this reinforces the perception that “regulators don’t approve of inflationary coins”—when Bitcoin faces regulatory pressure, assets that can be proven to have an “immutable total supply” are more defensive. This means:
1. Short-term sentiment favors XRP, but that may not translate into a sustained rally
2. Resistance above BTC $85K may weaken as XRP recovers
3. The Foundation’s “proactive transparency” communication approach could become a reference for other projects dealing with regulators

There are few historical precedents for similar events, but the surge in Ethereum address counts after its 2022 hard fork suggests that, after a technical vulnerability is fixed, the market pays closer attention to the sustainability of the fix. This XRP case is different: the vulnerability itself confirmed the effectiveness of the supply rules.

💡 I think XRP will find short-term support around $1.5. By shifting the deflationary rationale from a technical vulnerability to the fundamental nature of the blockchain, the Foundation is saying that as long as computing power continues to protect the ledger, the creation of new coins will remain prohibited. But this view would be invalidated if regulators introduced a policy requiring XRP to be forcibly burned, which would cause the entire deflationary narrative to collapse.

📰 XRP 1000亿上限成铁律？基金会终于说清漏洞真相

XRP Ledger Foundation 近期在社交平台X发文，为两周前的安全补丁做说明。基金会强调：XRP总量始终固定在1000亿，从未改变。所谓漏洞只是绕过创建规则的方法，补丁是堵住这个后门——就像汽车限速120，漏洞是让仪表盘显示180，修的是仪表盘不是加个涡轮。所有账本数据公开可查，新币产生必被记录。对XRP持有者来说，这是吃了一颗定心丸。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这次澄清直接击破了市场关于XRP总量失控的谣言。基金会将技术漏洞定性为"规则绕过"，而非"系统缺陷"，这把XRP的通缩模型重新锚定在区块链底层逻辑上。这意味着：
1. XRP的通缩属性是内生且不可改变的
2. 任何试图通过技术突破总量上限的行为都会被修复
3. 基金会这次主动切割与总量问题的联系，暗示后续监管沟通将更聚焦合规性而非通胀风险

对比近期其他链的通胀争议（如Solana的代币经济学调整），XRP的固定总量反而凸显了其差异化优势。更深层看，这标志着去中心化项目治理从"功能优先"转向"规则至上"的新阶段。

对市场的影响
对XRP的影响是阶段性的心理修复。短期内，看空者会因缺乏新币创造机制而调整立场。但对BTC/ETH来说，这反而强化了"监管不认可通胀币"的认知——当比特币面临监管压力时，能被证明"总量不可变"的资产更具防御性。这意味着：
1. 短期情绪利好XRP，但未必转化为持续上涨
2. BTC $85K上方阻力或因XRP修复而减弱
3. 基金会这种"主动透明"的沟通模式，可能成为其他项目应对监管的参考样本

历史上类似事件参考不多，但2022年以太坊硬分叉后地址数激增案例表明，技术漏洞修复后，市场更关注修复后的可持续性。XRP这次不同，漏洞本身就验证了总量规则的有效性。

💡 我认为XRP $1.5附近会形成短期支撑。基金会这次把通缩逻辑从技术漏洞转移到区块链本质，意味着只要算力继续保护账本，新币创造就会永远被禁止。但失效条件是：如果出现监管机构要求强制销毁XRP的政策，那整个通缩叙事都会崩塌。

📰 Why Is South Korea Introducing Tokenized Bonds? What Does the Expansion of Tokenized Securities Mean?

South Korea’s financial regulators want to bring blockchain to bonds and funds, and they’re currently seeking public feedback on a draft proposal. Previously, South Korea only allowed tokenization of real estate and art; this time, stocks are included too. When will it take effect? February 4 next year. This is clearly an effort to expand the scope of blockchain applications and bring traditional finance along for the ride into Web3.

Why does this news matter?

South Korea is one of the governments most actively regulating digital assets worldwide. So why is it suddenly looking to tokenize bonds and funds? Simply put, it’s trying to solve three longstanding challenges facing traditional finance as it embraces blockchain: ① reducing transaction costs (digital securities are much more convenient than paper ones), ② improving liquidity (people used to buy bonds in one lump; now they can be split into smaller units), and ③ attracting younger investors (young people aren’t put off by tokens). South Korea started with real estate and art, and has now added stocks. The natural next step is bonds and funds, which offer more stable returns but somewhat lower liquidity.

Impact on the market
This is a major positive for the crypto market, but it’s not a game changer. It means that in the future, ordinary people may be able to invest in bonds through digital accounts, in addition to trading on the secondary market. This could divert some traditional capital into the crypto sector. For BTC and ETH, the short-term impact may simply be a boost to sentiment, since South Korea is a major economy and policy moves like this will attract attention from other countries. But it’s too early to say whether this can drive innovation in crypto assets over the medium term. Historically, regulatory innovation has often come with risks. For example, it would be hard to recreate the kind of nationwide crypto-buying frenzy seen in 2017 today.

💡 Personal view: South Korea’s push to tokenize bonds is a plus for BTC and ETH, but the impact is limited. This view would only hold if we later see the US or EU follow suit with similar policies. For now, let’s see whether $2.5K holds and can help other established coins stabilize as well.

📰 为什么韩国要搞债券通？Token化证券扩张意味着什么？

韩国金融监管机构要给债券和基金也搞上区块链，现在在搞草案公示。以前韩国只能给房子和艺术品搞Token化，这次把股票也纳入。具体啥时候实施？明年2月4日。这明显是想把区块链应用范围扩大，让传统金融也搭上Web3的快车。

为什么这条新闻重要？
韩国是全球数字资产监管最积极的政府之一，他们为啥突然要给债券和基金Token化？简单说，是为了解决传统金融拥抱区块链的三个老大难问题：①降低交易成本（数字券比纸券方便多了），②提高资金流动性（以前买债券是闭着眼睛买，现在能拆分成小块），③吸引年轻投资者（年轻人对Token这玩意儿不反感）。你看他们先是搞了房产和艺术品，现在把股票也加进去，下一步自然就是收益更稳定但流动性稍低的债券和基金了。

对市场的影响
这对加密市场来说是个大利好，但不至于翻天覆地。意味着未来除了二级市场炒作，普通人还能通过数字账户参与债券投资，这会分流一部分传统资金进入加密领域。对BTC和ETH来说，短期可能就是情绪提振，因为韩国是主要经济体，这种政策动向会引发其他国家的关注。但中期能不能推动加密资产品种创新，现在还不好说。历史上看，监管创新往往伴随风险，比如2017年那种全民炒币的疯劲儿，现在再复制就难了。

💡 个人观点：韩国推动债券Token化对BTC和ETH是个加分项，但影响有限。如果未来能看到美国或欧盟跟风推出类似政策，这个判断才成立。目前守住$2.5K这个价位，看能不能带动其他老牌币种一起稳住。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What Kind of Candle Do You Usually FOMO Into?
translatedData.subTitle:
The coin price shoots up with a big bullish candle, everyone in the group is yelling “Go, go, go!” and you nervously chase in—only to end up buying at
the top. This scenario plays out every day.

Look closely at that big bullish candle that gets your heart racing: it’s what people who are already fully invested hope you’ll chase in and take it
off their hands. Chasing after a sharp, high-volume rally is essentially providing liquidity to those who were already holding.

A simple but effective rule: when you feel like chasing, make yourself wait for three candles. If the pullback comes on declining volume and stabilizes,
you’ll get a better entry; if it drops straight back down, congratulations—you’ve saved yourself an expensive lesson. The market will always
give you a second chance, but it won’t give you a second bankroll.

📰 South Korean Bank Issues Its First BTC-Backed Loan: Why Have Regulators Finally Eased Up?

South Korea’s Jeonbuk Bank has piloted the first-ever Korean won loan program of its kind, allowing customers to use BTC as collateral for business loans. This is the first time South Korean financial regulators have allowed a bank to issue loans backed solely by Bitcoin, after imposing strict restrictions on crypto assets. The bank does not take custody of the Bitcoin itself; instead, it entrusts custody to a licensed virtual asset service provider. In the event of a default, the bank will not seize the Bitcoin directly but will instead liquidate the collateral—a clever design that sidesteps the direct regulatory risks of handling cryptocurrency.

Why does this news matter?
South Korea is one of the developed countries with the strictest cryptocurrency regulations in the world. Previously, banks were prohibited from dealing with any crypto assets. Jeonbuk Bank’s pilot sends two key signals: first, South Korean regulators may be exploring ways to integrate traditional finance with crypto assets; second, banks see opportunities for regulatory arbitrage at the institutional level. Essentially, this model legitimizes the financial properties of crypto assets—their role as a store of value and as collateral—within a compliant framework. If regulators give it the green light, we could see more innovations like this in the future.

Market impact
The effect on BTC/ETH is likely to be driven more by sentiment. In the short term, the news could boost confidence in cryptocurrency adoption across Asian markets and lift sentiment toward crypto as a whole. But its long-term significance will depend largely on whether regulations continue to ease and create a virtuous cycle. Historically, innovations like this often go through periods of policy uncertainty—for example, the shifting caution of U.S. banks toward blockchain technology. So the market should watch whether South Korea expands the pilot, perhaps by adding other crypto assets or easing restrictions on corporate clients.

💡 This is a bullish signal, but only if South Korea can roll out the model to more banks and crypto assets. If regulations tighten in the future or banks continue to show little interest, the bullish thesis no longer holds.

📰 韩国银行首次用BTC贷款：为什么监管终于松口了？

韩国第一银行Jeonbuk Bank试点了史上首个韩元贷款计划，客户可以用BTC抵押获得经营性贷款。这是韩国金融监管机构在严格限制加密资产品种后，首次允许银行以比特币作为单一抵押品发放贷款。银行不接触比特币实物，而是委托持牌虚拟资产服务商保管。一旦违约，银行不会直接没收比特币，而是选择清算抵质押品，这种设计巧妙规避了加密货币的直接监管风险。

为什么这条新闻重要？
韩国是全球对加密货币监管最严的发达国家之一，此前银行不得触碰任何加密资产。Jeonbuk银行的试点释放出两个关键信号：第一，韩国监管层可能正在探索传统金融与加密资产的融合路径；第二，银行意识到机构级监管套利机会。这个模式本质上是在合规框架下将加密资产品种的金融属性（价值存储和抵押功能）合法化，意味着如果监管成功，未来可能出现更多类似创新。

对市场的影响
对BTC/ETH的影响更多是情绪推动。短期内看，消息可能提振亚洲市场对加密货币接受度的信心，利好加密货币整体情绪。但长期价值更多取决于监管能否持续放开并形成良性循环。历史上，类似创新往往需要经历政策摇摆期——比如美国银行对区块链技术的谨慎态度反复——因此市场需要关注韩国后续是否扩大试点范围，比如增加其他加密资产或放宽企业客户限制。

💡 看多这个信号，但前提是韩国能将此模式推广到更多银行和加密品种。如果未来监管收紧或银行参与度持续低迷，这个看多逻辑就作废了。

📰 Why Does Starknet Want to Build an Independent Layer 1? How Urgent Is the Quantum Threat?

Starknet has announced that it is considering leaving Ethereum and becoming an independent, quantum-resistant Layer 1 network. It aims to build this new chain by 2027 and break free from its reliance on Ethereum for security. STRK’s losses have surged to 116.7% over the past 7 days, but there’s no timeline yet for the move.

Why does this news matter?
Starknet’s move is driven by the threat of quantum computing. The elliptic-curve cryptography used by cryptocurrencies today—such as Ethereum’s secp256k1—could one day be broken by quantum computers. If that happens, all existing public blockchains could become obsolete. Starknet’s goal of quantum resistance is essentially an engine replacement for all of Web3, aimed at preventing the technology from being held back by the laws of physics. This isn’t just a technical upgrade; it’s a fight for survival.

Market impact
In the short term, Starknet’s plan to build an independent Layer 1 could be good news for STRK holders. The long-term outlook splits in two: optimists see this as the only way for Web3 to outrun regulatory and physical threats, and expect more chains to pursue quantum resistance; pessimists worry that it will dilute Ethereum’s ecosystem advantage, and that an independent chain’s tokenomics will struggle to match those of established public blockchains. A historical comparison is Cosmos’s IBC protocol. It was also intended to break away from centralization, but the ecosystem ended up becoming more dependent on individual chains.

How to approach it
If Starknet’s independence plan succeeds, STRK may be able to escape the squeeze of the Ethereum ecosystem. But quantum resistance is a marathon, not something that can be achieved overnight. If there’s still no sign of quantum cryptography being cracked by 2027, STRK may remain just another Layer 2 project. Hold the psychological price level of $0.11; a break below it would suggest this bet is lost.

📰 AI Hacks Ledger in Europe, XRP Overflow Vulnerability Unresolved: Why Can’t Regulators Focus Only on Major Exchanges?

Ledger users in France have reported that mining rigs were hacked, possibly involving the European market, though Ledger has yet to confirm this. The news also comes alongside a newly disclosed XRP vulnerability. NS3.AI found that Ledger devices had been modified in the Asian market, with estimated losses of $93.4M. Veria Labs discovered an XRP overflow vulnerability that could have created an extra 18 trillion XRP, and received a $250,000 bounty. These incidents raise an important question: How do we secure the rest of the ecosystem beyond exchanges?

Why does this news matter?
The Ledger hack is the most significant part, because Ledger doesn’t hold users’ funds. The mining rigs were merely a stepping stone, suggesting that directly attacking hardware may be becoming easier. The involvement of the European market means the attackers may be more sophisticated, and that this isn’t just happening in Asia. The XRP vulnerability was alarming in scale, but Veria found it before it caused any actual losses. That’s actually evidence of progress in institutional security: vulnerabilities may have existed for a long time, but they were discovered and fixed in time.

Market impact
There’s no short-term impact on BTC/ETH, but in the long term, this will reinforce the importance of decentralized hardware wallets. Regulators can’t focus only on major exchanges like Binance; they also need to oversee the security of widely used devices like Ledger. If regulators turn their attention to this area, compliant companies like Ledger could benefit from a stronger brand reputation. In terms of fund flows, some people may move from centralized wallets to hardware wallets, but the scale is likely to remain limited for now.

Trading outlook
BTC/ETH are currently neutral, but the Ledger incident means concerns about assets held outside exchanges are likely to grow. If BTC falls to $81K, those concerns could prompt risk-averse investors to pull out. This assessment would no longer apply if further reports emerge of Ledger devices being compromised on a large scale.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Your brain is lying to you while you hold a losing position
translatedData.subTitle:
What is someone with a 50% unrealized loss looking at? The “all-time high,” thinking: If it gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out. Notice that this thought is all attachment, with no logic. The market doesn’t know your entry price,
It only responds to current supply and demand.

Once you start stubbornly holding a losing trade, you automatically collect bullish news and block out bearish news. This is called confirmation bias. You start thinking
“This time is different”—those five words have burned more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is actually simple, but hard to put into practice: before opening a position, write down “under what circumstances the logic behind this trade
fails,” then act when that point is reached, regardless of how you feel. Separate the decision from the position, and only then can you see clearly

【FNG falls from 63 to 57: I’m getting a familiar feeling】

Yesterday, AI-related stocks in South Korea crashed, and the A-share market wobbled too. What about crypto? BTC and ETH dipped first, then bounced back.

Interesting.

The FNG was 57 yesterday, with a weekly average of 63 today. The number has gone up, but sentiment is actually moving down. What does that tell us? The “greed” shell is still there, but the energy inside it is already starting to dissipate.

I’ve been through moments like this. The wave at the end of 2017 was far more extreme than what we’re seeing now. The FNG was off the charts every day. And then? Just when everyone thought “this time is different,” bam—it all changed in an instant.

What’s different now is that ETH has fallen 49.5% from its peak—almost by half. Historically, this is the kind of level that starts to catch the eye of long-term investors. But keeping an eye on it and actually buying are two different things.

Look at the charts. 2363 is the lifeline; 2586 is the ceiling. How long have we been bouncing around in this range? More than a week. There’s volume, but it’s not strong enough. What does that tell us? Everyone’s waiting—for a reason to push higher, or to dump lower.

There’s news that Russia’s Sberbank plans to launch BTC, ETH, and USDT trading in December. Sounds impressive, right? But this kind of news has never been the engine that drives a market. At best, it’s a little fuel on the fire. What can really get ETH moving is new money coming in—not existing funds being shuffled around.

What’s my mindset right now? Honestly, I’m itching a little, but not to chase the highs. It’s more like, “If it really drops, I want to buy the dip.” But my 2021 muscle memory tells me: don’t rush. Wait for it to show its hand first.

What about you? With the FNG heading down while prices are still holding up, would you dare to buy? Personally, I want to wait for it to break below 2363 and see if anyone steps in at that level. If nobody does, I’ll just keep watching.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A stop-loss isn't admitting you're wrong—it's a ticket you buy for the next opportunity
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people can't bring themselves to set a stop-loss because they treat it as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
can't get past it. Try looking at it another way: a stop-loss is insurance you've bought in advance; the premium is that small loss.
The difference between a professional and a gambler isn't who gets it right more often, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The steadiest trader I've ever seen cuts losses more decisively than anyone else. Because he knows: whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn't matter; what matters is the expected value across a hundred trades. Next time your hand trembles as you place a stop-loss, tell yourself
This is an entry ticket, not a verdict.

title: 山寨季是怎么轮动的？为什么你的币总是最后一个涨
subTitle:
很多人难受的点：BTC涨的时候我的山寨不动，山寨起飞的时候我又没在
车上。其实山寨轮动是有大致剧本的。

【经典顺序】BTC先动（吸走注意力）→ 资金外溢到ETH和大主流 →
再扩散到板块龙头 → 最后扫到各种小币杂毛 → 全场普涨过热，行情
接近尾声。你总感觉自己的币最后涨，因为你买的位置往往就在轮动
链条的末端。

【两个实用观察】1. BTC占比（BTC.D）下降，通常说明资金在往山寨流，
山寨季启动的信号之一；2. 山寨普涨但BTC滞涨，往往是行情进入尾声
的信号，这时候追高杂毛币，接盘概率最大。

【结论】轮动不是平均主义，不是每个山寨都会涨。有叙事、有真实
流通量、有板块地位的才轮得到。与其猜哪个百倍币，不如盯紧资金
现在在哪、下一站可能去哪。

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

“Rolling your profits” has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: start with a small amount of capital, use several times leverage to ride a big trend, roll your profits a few times,
and turn them into dozens of times your original capital. Today, let’s talk about what those stories leave out.

【How rolling your profits works】Instead of cashing out unrealized gains, you use them as risk capital for new positions and keep trading,
It’s basically using the market’s money to increase your leverage. As long as the trend continues, the compounding can be astonishing; once it stops, unrealized gains can go from
up dozens of points to zero in just one or two big bearish candles.

【The math】The essence of rolling your profits is getting it right repeatedly. If you have a 60% win rate, the chance of getting four wins in a row
is only 13%. Behind every post about doubling your money overnight are 99 people who’ve already deleted their accounts.

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

translatedData.title: Pyramiding: How to Add to a Trend Trade as It Rises Without Getting Burned
translatedData.subTitle:
If you’ve read the trend correctly and want to add to your position, how should you do it? Starting with a large position and then adding until you’re fully loaded on unrealized gains makes you a regular on the liquidation list.
The right approach is called pyramiding.

【Principle】Each time you add to your position, add less than you did the previous time. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first confirmed pullback,
After further confirmation, add 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position should be, keeping most of your cost basis low so you can withstand a pullback.

【Why the opposite is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, adding more and more at the top) means your
average cost is concentrated at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn profits into losses. Once you lose your nerve, your whole approach falls apart.

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% position-sizing rule: Why being able to take losses helps you survive longer
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on any single trade
shouldn’t exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means losing no more than 200 U on a single trade. After 10 consecutive losses, you’d still have 8,000,
With just a 20% drawdown, a few winning trades can get your account back on track. By contrast, if you go all-in and lose 30% each time,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34% of your capital. You’d need to nearly double it to break even—the math has all but sentenced you to failure.

【How to put it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size under 2%.” It’s “make sure the amount you lose if this trade hits its stop-loss
doesn’t exceed 2%.” So the right order is: identify your stop-loss level → calculate the distance to it → work out your position size.

Honestly, the real finale often comes after the calm. Looking at $ETH now, this level doesn’t feel decisively strong to me. Instead, after the rise, some people are starting to hesitate. The move upward isn’t being supported as smoothly as before, and whenever it pulls back, selling pressure comes in quickly. You could say it has turned completely weak—but not quite. Still, the risk-reward of chasing it higher is clearly getting worse. This is when it’s easiest to get swept along by the market: seeing it push up and fearing you’ll miss out, then seeing it plunge and panicking into a sell. Do that a few times, and you lose your rhythm completely.

I’d rather treat this stretch as a time to observe. A pullback itself isn’t scary; what’s scary is when it fails to recover properly afterward. If each rebound is weaker than the last and the highs keep failing to rise, it means people above are in a greater hurry to get out. Patience matters more than prediction here. Don’t change your whole outlook because of an hour of volatility, and don’t think you’ve missed everything just because of one bullish candle. $ETH  looks more like it’s wearing down sentiment than rewarding impulsiveness.

So my bias is clear: bearish. I’m not certain it’s about to drop immediately, but at this level I’d rather wait for it to move lower. If it proves this thesis wrong with a strong move, so be it—the market matters more than stubbornly sticking to your view.

⚠️ But here's the part many traders overlook:

A headline CPI surprise doesn't automatically determine Bitcoin's direction. Core inflation, Treasury yields, the dollar, and the Fed's interest-rate outlook all matter.

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。
手里的利润单，最怕的就是抱着抱着变成亏损单。

translatedData.title: Staged profit-taking: How to lock in gains while letting profits run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than setting a stop-loss, because a stop-loss cuts through fear, while taking profits means cutting through greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell, then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the staged profit-taking approach I've been using.

【Three stages】Stage one: when it reaches the first target (for example, a 1:1 reward-to-risk ratio), close 1/3 of the position to lock in some profits,
At this point, the trade is risk-free, and your mindset changes instantly. Stage two: when it reaches the second target
(for example, a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio), take another 1/3 off. Stage three: let a trailing stop manage the rest; exit if it falls below the moving average
or the previous low, and let your profits run.

【Why this works】If you exit the whole position too early, you'll kick yourself. If you hold the whole position, it often feels like riding an elevator back to square one.

📰 Why can tokenized stocks trade around the clock on Solana and BNB?

According to CoinTelegraph, nearly $330 million in tokenized stock trading volume now takes place outside Wall Street trading hours—on Solana and BNB Chain. Investors no longer have to wait for the U.S. stock market to close; they can trade these digital stocks anytime, and trading volume is no small amount.

Why does this news matter?

The main reason is that the speed and cost advantages of trading on crypto blockchains are now drawing business away from traditional finance in a very real way. Institutions used to avoid crypto because they considered it unsafe or noncompliant. Now even stock trading—which requires regulatory compliance—is starting to move on-chain. This shows that crypto technology has moved beyond the “proof of concept” stage and is beginning to solve real-world problems. For example, Solana’s TerraFi can keep trading latency below 30 ms—a speed that even Wall Street’s traditional systems would envy.

Market impact

For the crypto market landscape, this means the barriers protecting traditional centralized exchanges are starting to break down. If stock trading can move on-chain, could other regulated assets follow suit in the future? For BTC/ETH, this news is neutral to mildly positive—it shows that the crypto market is building a self-contained ecosystem of its own and no longer needs to constantly watch the U.S. stock market. However, it may not directly drive prices higher in the short term, because this is merely technological progress; it takes time for gradual change to become a major shift.

Trading strategy

For now, this news mainly benefits on-chain asset infrastructure rather than any specific token. This view could change if regulators clearly endorse on-chain stock trading in the future. Simply put: the money hasn’t left the stock market, but investors are starting to feel comfortable letting it sleep on Solana and BNB Chain for a few extra hours.

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.title: Where Should You Place Your Stop-Loss? How I Choose Between Technical Levels and Percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where to place your stop matters more than whether to use one. Too close, and you’ll get stopped out every day; too far, and one loss can wreck you.

【Fixed-Percentage Method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your principal. Simple and straightforward—suitable for beginners
and helps build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop might land right in a cluster of other traders’ stops.

【Technical-Level Stop-Loss Method】Place it where the structure becomes invalid: for a long position, below key support; for a short position,
above resistance. The logic is—if price breaks through this level, that’s evidence I was wrong.
Work backward from your position size: if the stop distance is large, reduce your position size to ensure the loss on any single trade is still a set percentage of your principal

📰 What does it mean when a South Korean bank accepts Bitcoin as collateral?

South Korea’s first Chinese-funded bank, Jeonbuk Bank, has reportedly begun offering businesses loans secured by Bitcoin—a relatively new practice. According to reports, the Bitcoin is held by a third party, and new rules that took effect on October 1 allow banks to sell Bitcoin directly through the courts without necessarily taking possession of it themselves, making it easier to recover collateral. Specific loan amounts and interest rates have not been disclosed. Jeonbuk Bank has not made an official statement.

Why is this news important?
The key point is that South Korean financial institutions are beginning to explore using cryptocurrencies as collateral. South Korea is one of the world’s most active cryptocurrency trading markets, with particularly high participation from domestic investors. Banks’ ability to accept Bitcoin as collateral means:
1. Cryptocurrencies are gaining greater acceptance within South Korea’s financial system
2. Domestic businesses have more options for crypto-related financing
3. Through this new business, banks can gain greater exposure to crypto assets and may also participate in over-the-counter market making
This reflects the growing adoption of crypto assets in traditional financial settings, particularly in Asian markets where regulators take a relatively supportive approach.

Market impact
Looking at how the effects may be transmitted, this news is likely to affect BTC and ETH mainly through market sentiment. South Korea is one of the world’s most active cryptocurrency trading markets, and the transmission path from domestic capital outflows to selling pressure on BTC has long existed. Now that banks are beginning to accept Bitcoin as collateral, this could theoretically become a factor supporting local prices:
1. Businesses that need Bitcoin as collateral can obtain financing directly from banks instead of buying it on the secondary market
2. Banks may need to hold a certain amount of BTC in their asset reserves, indirectly adding to demand
3. The financialization of crypto assets across South Korea is increasing, which could contribute to more rational asset pricing over the long term
In the short term, however, this mainly confirms that South Korean regulators are taking an open approach to crypto assets. South Korea’s regulatory framework for cryptocurrencies is relatively friendly by global standards, and banks were previously allowed to participate in cryptocurrency trading businesses.

Trading outlook
The significance of this news for BTC and ETH lies more in its validation of the long-term trend. BTC is currently at $83,249.95 and ETH at $2,509.28. Overall market sentiment is still influenced by U.S. Treasury yields and institutional capital flows. Banks accepting Bitcoin as collateral is a fact, but it will not change the main drivers of prices in the short term. If more South Korean financial institutions become involved in the crypto asset ecosystem, this thesis may gain strength. If regulations suddenly tighten or anti-crypto policies emerge in the United States, however, this thesis would no longer hold.

📰 韩国银行借比特币当抵押，到底意味着什么？

韩国首家中资银行Jeonbuk Bank据说开始给企业发比特币抵押贷款了，这个做法比较新鲜。新闻说比特币由第三方保管，而且从10月1号开始的新规定允许银行通过法院直接卖掉比特币而不一定自己拿走，这样回收抵押物更方便。具体贷款金额、利率啥的没透露。Jeonbuk Bank没给官方说法。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这件事的核心是韩国金融机构开始尝试用加密货币做抵押品。韩国是全球加密交易最活跃的市场之一，本土资金参与度特别高。银行现在能用比特币做抵押，这意味着：
1. 加密货币在韩国金融系统中的认可度提升了
2. 本土企业获得加密相关融资的渠道变多了
3. 银行通过这个新业务能接触更多加密资产，也可能参与场外交易做市
这反映了加密资产在传统金融场景的应用正在落地，特别是在亚洲市场，监管相对积极的地方。

对市场的影响
从传导路径看，这个消息对BTC和ETH的影响主要是情绪层面。韩国是全球加密交易最活跃市场之一，本土资金抽离→BTC抛压的传导路径一直存在。现在银行开始接受比特币抵押，理论上可能反过来成为支撑本地币价的一个因素：
1. 需要比特币做抵押的企业可以直接从银行获取融资，而不是直接从二级市场买入
2. 银行可能需要配置一定量的BTC做资产储备，这间接增加了需求
3. 整个韩国加密资产的金融化程度在提高，长期看有利于资产定价的合理化
但短期内，这更多是验证韩国监管对加密资产的态度是开放式的。目前韩国对加密货币的监管框架在全球算比较友好的，之前还允许银行参与加密货币交易业务。

操作思路
这个新闻对BTC和ETH的意义更多在于长期趋势验证。目前BTC $83,249.95，ETH $2,509.28，整体市场情绪仍受美债利率和机构资金流向影响。银行接受比特币抵押是一个事实，但短期内不会改变价格主要驱动力。如果未来韩国出现更多金融机构参与加密资产生态，这个逻辑才可能加强。如果监管突然收紧，或者美国那边出现反加密资产的政策动向，这个逻辑就不再成立了。

Some wallets and block explorers flag or hide by default zero-value transfers suspected of being part of address poisoning.

🚨 $800M liquidated overnight, yet BTC bounced back in a V-shape to $84K—who got shaken out in this shakeout?

Yesterday, 170,000 people across the market were liquidated, totaling $815 million. Longs took a brutal $689 million hit, and BTC briefly wicked down to $80.9K. And then? It reclaimed $84K within 24 hours, climbed above $83K today, and ETH gained 3.65% in a catch-up rally.

Think this is panic? I see a changing of hands:

🐋 Whales are accumulating. Since October, BTC whales have added around 30,000 coins, worth more than $1.2 billion. The prices where retail investors are selling at a loss are exactly where whales are stepping in.

🔄 Smart money is rotating. One whale sold 837 BTC (about $70 million) and put the money into 27,500 ETH at an average price of $2,534. ETH is outperforming BTC today—this portfolio rotation is paying off.

📉 Leverage has been flushed out. Total liquidations across the market plunged to $160 million today, with shorts now getting squeezed as the trend reverses. The long-side flush is over, and the powder is dry again.

🔥 Institutions haven’t retreated. Strategy keeps buying, with total holdings worth $70 billion; Citi raised its BTC price target to $113,000. ETF outflows? That’s about the interest-rate environment, not a collapse in conviction.

⚠️ But don’t rush to chase the price—the CPI report tomorrow is make-or-break. The dollar’s 5.21% yield hangs like a sword of Damocles: hotter-than-expected data, and $80K is back in play; mild data, and if $84,000 breaks, the previous high of $86,790 is right in sight.

The short-term playbook in one sentence: a pullback to $82K–$83K is a golden buying opportunity; chasing at $84K is a gamble. For ETH, watch $2,460–$2,490, with a stop-loss at $2,405 and a take-profit at $2,640.

The market waits for no one, but it rewards those who understand leverage. Manage your position size. Staying in the game matters more than anything.

🚨 深夜爆仓 8 亿，BTC 却 V 型拉回 8.4 万——这波洗盘，洗的是谁？

昨天全网 17 万人爆仓 8.15 亿美元，多单被血洗 6.89 亿，BTC 一度插针 8.09 万。结果呢？24 小时内收复 8.4 万，今天站上 8.3 万，ETH 补涨 3.65%。

你以为这是恐慌？我看到的是一张换手桌：

🐋 鲸鱼在接筹。10 月以来 BTC 巨鲸吸筹约 3 万枚，价值 12 亿美元+。散户割肉的地方，正是鲸鱼进场的价格。

🔄 聪明钱在轮动。有鲸鱼直接卖出 837 枚 BTC（约 7000 万美元）换入 2.75 万枚 ETH，均价 2,534。今天 ETH 跑赢 BTC——这波调仓，正在兑现。

📉 杠杆被清干净了。今天全网爆仓骤降到 1.6 亿，方向反转为空头被轧。多头清洗结束，弹药重新上膛。

🔥 机构没有撤退。Strategy 继续买，总持仓 700 亿美元；花旗上调 BTC 目标价至 11.3 万。ETF 流出？那是利率环境，不是信仰崩塌。

⚠️ 但别急着追——明天 CPI 是生死关。美元 5.21% 的收益率像达摩克利斯之剑，数据超预期，8 万见；数据温和，84,000 一破，前高 86,790 就在眼前。

短期剧本就一句话：回踩 8.2~8.3 万是黄金坑，追高 8.4 万是赌运气。ETH 看 2,460~2,490，止损 2,405，止盈 2,640。

行情不会等任何人，但会奖励懂杠杆的人。控制仓位，活下去，比什么都重要。

Are Funds Flowing Back Into ETH ETFs? This Table Is Still Missing Two Entries

$ETH Yesterday, ETH rebounded from around 2409 to above 2500. At least it didn’t continue plunging. I’m more inclined to think it will keep trading around 2500 USDT before tonight’s CPI release. It hasn’t managed to hold yesterday’s high near 2538, and the ETF inflow figures aren’t complete yet.

According to Farside’s table, US ETH ETFs saw net outflows for ten consecutive trading days from September 29 to October 12, totaling about $780 million. As of now, October 13 shows a provisional net inflow of $24.8 million, but the entries for BlackRock’s ETHA and ETHB are still blank, so the total could change once they’re filled in.

ETHA saw outflows several times in the preceding days, so we can’t treat these two missing entries as zero. It’s certainly good that some funds are flowing in, but it’s too early to say the entire ETF market has turned around, or to use this as an explanation for why ETH rose yesterday.

On the hourly chart, ETH pulled back after climbing to around 2538 yesterday, and has been trading around 2500 this morning. For the rebound to continue, it first needs to break above yesterday’s high and hold steady on a retest. If it can’t even hold yesterday evening’s low near 2489, I’d be more inclined to think this recovery needs another pullback.

US September CPI will be released tonight at 8:30. The data could break this period of consolidation. Price has already rebounded; next, we’ll see whether ETF funds can follow. If the complete figures also turn positive and inflows continue over the next few days, this rebound will have a stronger foundation.

title: 交易心理 | 市场情绪周期：从怀疑到狂喜的六幕剧
subTitle:
每一轮行情的剧本几乎一样：
① 怀疑期：涨了几天，没人信，都在喊反弹出货。
② 认同期：创了新高，分析师开始翻多，散户半信半疑上车。
③ 兴奋期：连续拉涨，群里开始晒收益，你开始怕踏空。
④ 狂喜期：朋友圈都在讨论币，出租车司机荐币，杠杆率飙高。
⑤ 否认期：开始下跌，所有人说是「健康回调，上车机会」。
⑥ 恐慌期：连续暴跌，割肉声一片——而下一轮的种子就埋在这里。

对照一下你现在处在哪一幕。赚大钱的机会在①和⑥，亏大钱的位置在
③和④。情绪不可消除，但可以标注：知道自己站在剧本第几幕的人，
不容易把结束当成开始。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | The Market Sentiment Cycle: A Six-Act Play from Doubt to Euphoria
translatedData.subTitle:
The script for every market cycle is almost the same:
① Doubt: Prices rise for a few days, but no one believes it. Everyone says it’s a rebound and time to sell.
② Acceptance: The market hits a new high, analysts turn bullish, and retail investors cautiously get in.
③ Excitement: Prices keep surging, people in the group start showing off their gains, and you begin to fear missing out.
④ Euphoria: Everyone on social media is talking about crypto, taxi drivers are recommending coins, and leverage is soaring.
⑤ Denial: Prices start falling, and everyone says, “It’s a healthy correction—a chance to get in.”
⑥ Panic: Prices plunge repeatedly, and everyone is selling at a loss—yet this is where the seeds of the next cycle are planted.

【Why are traditional banks suddenly rushing into crypto?】

There was some news yesterday that I didn’t think much of at the time. Looking back today, though, it’s pretty interesting: Sberbank, Russia’s largest bank, has received authorization to operate a crypto exchange and plans to launch trading in BTC, ETH, and USDT in December.

A lot of people might just scroll past this. But I stopped and thought about it for a few seconds.

Think about what this means: a traditional bank backed by the credibility of the state is actively looking to trade crypto assets. This isn’t some small-scale experiment—it’s a flare signaling that institutional capital is officially entering the market.

ETH is currently hovering around $2,500, with resistance at $2,586 and support at $2,437. In the short term, the market is waiting on technical indicators. It’s down 3.6% over the past seven days, but trading volume hasn’t picked up, suggesting both bulls and bears are sitting on the sidelines. At times like this, the biggest risk isn’t the price itself, but whether your read on the trend is still pointing in the right direction.

I’ve watched ETH climb to 14,000 and fall back to a few hundred since 2017. What has really caught my attention has never been the candlestick chart, but moves like this at the institutional level. Sberbank isn’t a retail investor. It’s done the math before getting involved—compliance costs, user base, capital allocation efficiency. It wouldn’t make a move unless the logic added up.

A 49% drawdown from the ATH certainly hurts. But viewed from another angle, periods like this have often been a window for long-term capital to rebuild positions. The difference this time is who’s entering the market: not some market maker, but a legitimate institution operating within a regulatory framework.

What does this mean in practice? ETH’s value proposition has taken another step away from “concept” and toward “real financial infrastructure.” Of course, it’s still a bit early to say all that. Let’s wait for trading volume to give us a clear signal first.

What are you watching? Do you think Sberbank’s move is driven by short-term sentiment, or does it signal a genuine trend?

content:
【传统银行为什么突然抢着进加密圈】

昨天有个消息我没太当回事，今天回看发现有点意思——俄罗斯最大银行Sberbank拿到加密交易所授权了，12月准备上线BTC、ETH、USDT交易。

很多人看到这个可能就划走了。但我停下来想了几秒钟。

你想想，这是什么性质的事？一家背靠国家信用的传统银行，主动要进来买卖加密资产。这不是小打小闹，这是机构资金正式进场的信号弹。

ETH现在价格卡在2500附近，上面2586是阻力，下面2437是支撑，短期就是在等技术数据。7天下跌3.6%，但成交量没有放大，说明多空都在观望。这种时刻，最怕的不是价格本身，而是你对趋势的判断是不是还在正确的方向上。

我从2017年看着ETH涨到过14000，也见过它跌回几百。真正让我有感觉的从来不是K线，而是这种机构层面的动作。Sberbank不是散户，它进来是算过账的——合规成本、用户基础、资产配置效率，逻辑讲得通才会动。

49%的回撤从ATH看确实疼。但换个角度，历史上这种区间往往是长线资金重新建仓的窗口。只是这回进场的人变了，不是什么庄家，是有监管框架的正规军。

这事落到实处意味着什么？ETH的价值支撑从"概念"往"真实金融基础设施"又挪了一步。当然，现在说这些还有点早，先让成交量给出明确信号再说。

你们盯什么？Sberbank这波操作，你们觉得是短期情绪还是真实趋势？

On October 12, U.S. Ethereum spot ETFs recorded approximately $85.39 million in net outflows, marking their 10th consecutive trading day of net redemptions. Since the losing streak began on September 29, cumulative outflows have approached $783 million, with October 6’s $202 million marking the largest single-day outflow of this period. By fund, BlackRock’s ETHA saw $75.07 million in outflows that day, about 88% of the total, while Grayscale’s Mini Trust saw $10.33 million in outflows. The other products were largely flat. These ETFs still have historical cumulative net inflows of $13.174 billion and net assets of $15.858 billion, equal to 5.15% of ETH’s total market capitalization—so their underlying base remains fairly substantial.

Interestingly, on the same day, $ETH  rebounded from a low of $2,409 to climb back above $2,500, and is now around $2,517. Corporate treasuries, meanwhile, are adding to their holdings: BitMine disclosed that it held more than 6.02 million $ETH as of October 11, about 4.9% of the circulating supply, with roughly 84% already staked. It also added 12,500 ETH last week. ETF redemptions, corporate accumulation, and a price rebound all happening at once suggest that sellers and buyers are taking turns stepping in at different points.

How should we read this? ETF outflows don’t necessarily mean the market is selling off. Redemptions are often driven by passive institutional investors rebalancing after the sharp volatility in early October, while active buyers like BitMine are building positions precisely when prices pull back. The real test comes tonight: U.S. September CPI is due at 8:30 p.m. Beijing time, with markets expecting headline inflation of 3.6%–3.7% and core inflation to ease to 2.4%–2.5%. 美东时间 10 月 12 日，美国以太坊现货 ETF 录得约 8539 万美元净流出，这是连续第 10 个交易日出现净赎回。自 9 月 29 日连跌开始，累计流出已接近 7.83 亿美元，10 月 6 日的 2.02 亿美元是这轮单日最大。结构上，贝莱德 ETHA 当日流出 7507 万美元，约占总量的 88%，灰度迷你信托流出 1033 万美元，其余产品基本持平。目前这类 ETF 历史累计净流入还有 131.74 亿美元，净资产规模 158.58 亿美元，占 ETH 总市值的 5.15%，底子还算厚。

有意思的是同一天：$ETH 从 2409 美元低点反弹，重新站上 2500 美元，现价约 2517 美元。企业金库反而在加仓——BitMine 披露截至 10 月 11 日持有超 602 万枚 $ETH，占流通量约 4.9%，其中约 84% 已质押，上周还增持了 1.25 万枚。ETF 赎回、企业囤币、价格反弹三者同框，说明减持和买盘正在错位接力。

怎么看：ETF 净流出不等于市场在抛售。赎回多是被动配置型机构在 10 月初大幅波动后的再平衡；而 BitMine 这类主动型买盘，恰恰在价格回调时建仓。真正的考验是今晚：北京时间 20:30 美国 9 月 CPI 公布，市场预期总体通胀 3.6%–3.7%、核心回落至 2.4%–2.5%。数据偏热，十连阴大概率续上第 11 天；低于预期，ETF 资金反而可能回流，$ETH 也有了测试 2600 美元的机会。

以上不构成投资建议，DYOR，交易有风险。

title: Cboe BZX多币种加密期权规则生效：门槛替代「点名」
subTitle:
真正值得记的不是「又多一个产品」，而是规则从点名批准，切到了通用门槛。

SEC 10月13日发布 Notice（Release No. 34-106648，文件号 SR-CboeBZX-2026-082）：Cboe BZX 修改 Rule 19.3 / 19.4，建立「持有多种加密资产的 commodity-based trust」期权通用上市与持续上市标准，并同步放开符合 Rule 6c-11 的 ETF 期权路径。30 天生效等待被豁免，规则随备案即时生效——实质对齐此前已获批的 Cboe Options 框架。

硬门槛不糊弄：信托里每一种底层加密资产，过去 12 个月日均全球市值至少 $700M；且该资产须有衍生品在具备全面监管共享协议的市场交易（直接协议或共同 ISG 成员即可）。不达标，交易所要按月评估，考虑暂停新开仓。产品名单式点名也被拿掉，改走通用标准。

一句话：这是市场结构升级，不是替你挑基金。文件明确——不批准任何具体产品，也不保证某只会被挂出。备案后 60 天内 SEC 仍可临时叫停；公众可就该文件号提交评论。

对盯 $BTC、$ETH 现货与衍生品衔接的人，这意味着多资产加密信托期权有了可复制的上市剧本，而不是每次都从零讲故事。细节以 SEC 原文为准。

不构成投资建议。

translatedData.title: Cboe BZX’s Multi-Crypto Options Rule Takes Effect: General Criteria Replace “Specific Designation”
translatedData.subTitle:
What’s really worth noting isn’t “one more product,” but that the rules have shifted from approval by specific designation to a set of general criteria.

On October 13, the SEC issued a Notice (Release No. 34-106648, File No. SR-CboeBZX-2026-082): Cboe BZX amended Rules 19.3 and 19.4 to establish generic initial and continued listing standards for options on commodity-based trusts holding multiple crypto assets, while also opening an options pathway for ETFs that qualify under Rule 6c-11. The 30-day effectiveness waiting period was waived, so the rule took effect upon filing—essentially aligning it with the Cboe Options framework approved earlier.

Ethereum Market Deep Dive: Persistent ETF Outflows Apply Pressure as Whale Accumulation Against the Trend Draws Attention

1. Price Trend Analysis

As of the morning of October 14 Beijing time, Ethereum was trading at $2,504, up slightly by 0.23% over the past 24 hours. The price fluctuated between $2,490 and $2,520, with the market generally showing weak, range-bound movement. During the session, the price tested resistance near $2,520 several times but failed to break through decisively. This level coincides with the 99-period EMA, creating significant technical pressure.

In terms of fund flows, spot Ethereum ETFs have recorded net outflows for 10 consecutive trading days. On October 12, outflows totaled $85.4 million in a single day, marking the largest cumulative five-day outflow since January. Continued institutional redemptions have clearly weighed on the price. However, on-chain data shows that large entities accumulated more than 35,000 ETH over the past three days, worth approximately $90 million. This countertrend buying by whales suggests that market participants remain divided over Ethereum’s medium- to long-term value.

2. Technical Indicator Analysis

On the one-hour chart, the overall technical signals also point to a bearish outlook, with a composite indicator reading of -0.458 and a historical win rate of 76%. Of the 15 technical factors, seven are bullish, seven are bearish, and one is neutral. The bullish and bearish proportions are evenly balanced at 46.67% each, reflecting a typical wait-and-see market.

The MACD histogram has just turned positive, and the price has rebounded from the $2,490–$2,500 support zone, indicating some recovery in short-term momentum. However, the price remains capped by resistance near $2,520, around the 99-period EMA. If it cannot break through this level decisively, upside potential will remain limited. The RSI is also in neutral territory and, as with Bitcoin, offers no clear directional signal. Among the alpha factors, Alpha 3 and Alpha 11 are sending strong bearish signals, while Alpha 17 and Alpha 34 are bullish, highlighting an intense tug-of-war between buyers and sellers.

3. Market Sentiment Analysis

The central conflict in the Ethereum market is the contrast between ongoing institutional withdrawals and active accumulation by large on-chain holders. Persistent ETF outflows indicate that traditional institutional investors lack short-term confidence in Ethereum amid macroeconomic uncertainty. In particular, with U.S. Treasury yields rising and risk appetite declining, capital is more inclined to flow into assets perceived as more stable, such as Bitcoin.

However, Ethereum’s ecosystem continues to expand fundamentally. Major brokerages have opened Ethereum staking services to eligible clients, lowering the barriers for traditional investors to participate in DeFi. At the same time, a large amount of ETH is locked in staking contracts, objectively reducing the circulating supply and providing some underlying support for the price. In the short term, Ethereum needs to break through the key resistance at $2,520 to open up further upside; otherwise, it may continue consolidating within its current range. Investors are advised to closely monitor changes in ETF fund flows and guidance from macroeconomic data.

以太坊市场深度分析：ETF持续流出施压，鲸鱼逆势吸筹引关注

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间十月十四日上午，以太坊报价二千五百零四美元，过去二十四小时小幅上涨百分之零点二三。价格在二千四百九十至二千五百二十美元区间内波动，整体呈现弱势震荡格局。盘中价格多次测试二千五百二十美元附近的阻力位但未能有效突破，该位置恰好对应九十九周期EMA，形成了较强的技术压力。

从资金面来看，以太坊现货ETF已经连续十个交易日录得净流出，其中十月十二日单日流出八千五百四十万美元，创下一月以来最大的五日累计流出纪录。持续的机构赎回对价格形成了明显的压制。然而值得注意的是，链上数据显示有大型实体在过去三天内累计购入超过三万五千枚以太坊，总价值约九千万美元，鲸鱼的逆势吸筹行为暗示市场对以太坊中长期价值仍存在分歧。

二、技术指标解读

从一小时级别的技术指标来看，综合信号同样指向看空，综合指标数值为负零点四五八，历史胜率为百分之七十六。十五个技术因子中，七个看多，七个看空，一个中性，多空比例完全均衡，各占百分之四十六点六七，反映出市场处于典型的观望状态。

MACD柱状图刚刚翻正，价格也从二千四百九十至二千五百美元支撑区域反弹，短期动能有所恢复。但价格仍然受制于九十九周期EMA附近约二千五百二十美元的压力，若无法有效突破该位置，上行空间将受到限制。RSI指标同样处于中性区域，与比特币类似，缺乏明确的方向指引。alpha因子中，alpha三和alpha十一发出较强的看空信号，而alpha十七和alpha三十四则给出看多信号，多空博弈激烈。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场当前面临的核心矛盾在于机构端的持续撤离与链上大户的积极吸纳之间的对立。ETF的连续流出反映出传统机构投资者在宏观不确定性下对以太坊的短期信心不足，特别是美国国债收益率上升和风险偏好下降的大环境下，资金更倾向于流向比特币等更为稳健的资产。

但从基本面来看，以太坊生态仍在持续扩展。主要经纪商已面向合格客户开放以太坊质押服务，降低了传统投资者参与DeFi的门槛。同时，大量以太坊被锁定在质押合约中，客观上减少了流通供应量，为价格提供了一定的底部支撑。短期而言，以太坊需要突破二千五百二十美元的关键阻力位才能打开上行空间，否则可能继续在当前区间内震荡整理。建议投资者密切关注ETF资金流向的变化以及宏观数据的指引。

translatedData.content:
After BTC climbed back above 83K, many people focused on the same chart to debate where it was headed. But I care more about something else: the final bill for the same candlestick can look completely different depending on how the trade is executed.

Price is just a snapshot; the order environment is what’s happening on the ground.

You see the price hovering around 83K. What really determines whether a trade goes smoothly is whether the bid-ask spread has widened, whether the quote levels are continuous, whether your order size will reach deeper levels, and whether the trigger rules could send you into a worse execution range.

This is especially true when liquidity is fragmented. The chart may look like one market, but when you place an order, you could be dealing with different order books, different rules, and different routes. Your view on direction hasn’t changed, but the execution result can.

That’s why I now prefer to reverse the order of my pre-trade checks: look at the order environment first, then consider the price. How thin are the quote levels? Are there gaps in the depth? How far might the estimated fill be from the price you see? Could your choice of route add another layer of cost? These questions are closer to your actual profit and loss than “Did I get the direction right?”

That’s also where the value of an execution-focused comparison tool like PerpEX lies: it doesn’t make directional calls for you. It helps you understand, before you place an order, which route is more likely to get you a price close to what you expect.

title: ETH和Gas费：一条链的油钱是怎么回事
subTitle:
转账要交Gas费、mint个NFT要Gas费，这钱付给谁了？

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的
「油钱」。网络越堵，大家抢着执行，油价（Gas单价）越高。

【为什么和币价有关】行情火爆→链上交易暴增→Gas费飙升。所以老玩家
有个习惯：链上操作挑深夜或行情冷清的时候，同样的操作能省一半钱。

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，
挺有意思。

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What Does It Mean to Pay ‘Fuel Costs’ on a Blockchain?
translatedData.subTitle:
You pay gas fees to transfer tokens and to mint an NFT—but who gets that money?

【The basics】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transferring tokens, trading, running
a contract) uses computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who perform those computations.
“Fuel costs.” The more congested the network, the more people compete to get their transactions processed, and the higher the gas price (the price per unit of gas).

【Why it’s related to coin prices】A booming market → a surge in on-chain transactions → soaring gas fees. That’s why experienced users
have a habit: they do on-chain activities late at night or when the market is quiet. The same activity can cost half as much.

title: USDT为什么能锚定1美元？稳定币的运转原理
subTitle:
玩合约离不开USDT，但很多朋友没想过它凭什么值1美元。

【原理】稳定币由发行方运营：你给它1美元，它发给你1个USDT，并把
美元（及等值资产）存进储备。市场上谁想把USDT换回美元，就向发行
方赎回。这套「申购-赎回」机制像锚一样，把价格钉在1美元附近。
价格偶尔偏离一点点（比如0.999），套利者马上搬砖抹平。

【要关心的风险】储备透明度。USDT定期公布储备报告（含美债等资产），
但历史上稳定币圈出过事——储备不够的稳定币脱锚崩掉，持有人血本
无归。所以：大额资金别长期躺在单一稳定币里，分散是免费的保险。

translatedData.title: Why Is USDT Pegged to $1? How Stablecoins Work
translatedData.subTitle:
You can’t trade futures without USDT, but many people haven’t thought about why it’s worth $1.

【How it works】A stablecoin is operated by an issuer: you give it $1, and it gives you 1 USDT, while putting
dollars (and equivalent assets) into reserves. Anyone in the market who wants to exchange USDT back for dollars can go to the issuer to
redeem it from the issuer. This “mint-and-redeem” mechanism acts like an anchor, keeping the price close to $1.
The price occasionally deviates slightly (for example, to $0.999), and arbitrageurs quickly trade to bring it back in line.

Today, BTC climbed back above 83K. For many people, the first reaction is: Is the trend back?

But I’m more concerned about something else: Did your execution price keep up?

In a recovery, the cost most easily overlooked isn’t those few points in fees—it’s the execution slippage in the three seconds before and after you place an order. You see 83,600 on the screen, but your order may already have filled at the next price level. It may not be noticeable with a small position, but as your position grows, spreads, liquidity depth, refresh speed, and trigger conditions can all combine to erode your profit margin.

So my pre-trade checklist is simple:
First, check whether the spread has suddenly widened;
Next, see how many price levels your target quantity will consume;
Then, compare the estimated fill price with your acceptable price;
Finally, compare the order conditions across different execution routes.

The hotter the market gets, the more important it is not to focus only on the candlestick chart. Judging the direction is just the first step; order quality determines whether you’ve already lost ground by the time you enter.

For an execution-comparison perspective like PerpEX, I’d rather consider it before placing an order than only think of it during a post-trade review.

#BTC #ETH

💸 One address sold all 52,000 ETH, while another sold 1,074 BTC to buy ETH: one locked in gains, the other bet ETH would outperform BTC

ETH has just returned to around $2,500, but two large trades went in opposite directions: one address sold all 52,000 ETH it held, while another repeatedly sold BTC to buy ETH.

An address that traded ETH over the counter through Galaxy Digital bought a total of 52,000 ETH between July and September at an average price of $2,161, then began selling in late September at an average price of about $2,632. According to a report this morning, the address sold its final 10,000 ETH about five hours ago, worth around $25 million, completing the sale of the 52,000 ETH tracked in the report. (Foresight News, this morning, citing monitoring by on-chain analyst Ember.)

A rough calculation using the average buy and sell prices disclosed in the report: 52,000 × ($2,632 − $2,161) gives a paper price difference of about $24.49 million. This is not net profit after fees, slippage, or OTC costs. The average price at which the address sold in batches was about $120 higher than the current price this morning.

Another address sold 1,074.3 BTC over the past three days for $89.39 million in USDC, then bought 35,346 ETH at an average price of $2,529. Of those, 7,845 ETH were bought during the past day covered by the report. (Foresight News, citing monitoring by Ember.)

Looking at the three-day window (October 11, 10:00 a.m. to October 14, 10:00 a.m. Beijing time), Kraken hourly closing prices show ETH down 0.16% and BTC up 0.35%, meaning ETH underperformed BTC by about 0.5 percentage points. Over the last 24 hours, ETH made up some ground (ETH +1.73%, BTC +1.10%).

The current price this morning is $2,512.04 (11:04 a.m. Beijing time; Kraken spot last-traded price), slightly below the $2,529 average purchase price for the ETH acquired in the swap. If these ETH have not yet been sold, the position is currently showing an estimated paper loss of about 0.7% based on this morning’s price.

The address that sold has now completed the disposal of this batch of ETH; based on the average prices in the report, its price difference is positive. The swap was essentially a long bet on ETH/BTC, and its success depends on whether ETH can outperform BTC after the swap. But the two trades have different time horizons, so it is too early to simply judge which was the better move.

A. I agree more with selling in batches and locking in the price difference
B. I agree more with swapping BTC for ETH and betting on relative strength

#ETH #BTC #巨鲸

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Staying Flat Is a Position, Too—and It’s the One the Pros Use Most
translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest misconception beginners have is that if you’re not holding a position, you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, buying and selling every day,
until fees and market volatility whittle away their capital.

In reality, staying flat is the only position with zero losses. If you can’t make sense of the market, stay flat,
When bulls and bears are battling, stay flat; after a few losing trades in a row, stay flat—the money you save at these three moments
is worth more than what you make on most trades.

You may be tired of the hunting metaphor, but the point is true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes just a second. Keep your capital intact, and when an opportunity comes, you’ll have ammunition. Hold on to your ammunition.

83K rebound: first, let’s see how many levels of quotes this order will sweep

Today, the market recovered from around 82K to above 83K. The first thing many people wonder is: should I chase the move?

I’m more interested in another question: when you place this order, how many levels of quotes will it actually sweep?

Even if you’re looking at 83K, a great-looking top level in the order book doesn’t mean your target size can be filled at that price. What really affects the execution experience is often the depth beyond the second or third level, whether the bid-ask spread suddenly widens, whether quotes refresh quickly enough, and whether slippage occurs after the order is triggered.

In a rebound, the easiest mistake is to assume that “the price is back, so liquidity must be back too.” Often, the price recovers first, while the order-book environment lags behind. What you see is the recovery on the chart; what you actually pay for is the gap in the quote ladder.

My pre-trade checklist is simple: check the spread, see how many depth levels your target size will sweep, estimate slippage, then compare execution costs across different routes. Take your time judging direction, but don’t be careless about order quality.

That’s where an execution-focused perspective like PerpEX’s is valuable: it doesn’t tell you which way the market will go. It reminds you to check, before pressing the button, whether this order is likely to get “filled at an ugly price.”

以太坊市场深度分析：反弹动能初现，关注两千五百美元关口争夺

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间十月十四日凌晨，以太坊报价两千五百美元，过去二十四小时上涨约百分之一点七。从小时级别K线来看，价格在两千四百九十七至两千五百二十美元区间内波动，整体呈现窄幅震荡格局。盘中最高触及两千五百二十点五一美元，最低下探两千四百九十七美元，振幅相对有限。

从均线系统观察，当前价格位于七日均线两千五百零七美元附近，与二十五日均线两千五百一十一美元基本持平，短期均线呈现粘合状态。九十九日均线两千五百一十三美元位于价格上方，构成短期压力。七周期EMA为两千五百零七美元，二十五周期EMA为两千五百零九美元，同样处于粘合状态，说明市场正在积蓄能量，等待方向选择。

值得注意的是，以太坊近期从两千四百六十四美元低点反弹至两千五百美元上方，反弹幅度约百分之一点七，显示短期买盘有所回暖。但价格仍受到EMA九十九和布林带中轨的双重压制，突破这两道阻力将是确认反弹延续的关键。

二、技术指标解读

从综合信号指标来看，当前十五个因子中有七个发出做多信号，七个发出做空信号，一个中性，多空比例完全均衡，均为零点四七。复合指标数值为负零点三五，信号方向为做空，历史胜率为百分之七十九点一七。这一信号表明在当前均衡格局下，短期偏空的概率略高。

具体指标方面，RSI六周期为五十一点二零，RSI十二周期为四十九点七四，RSI二十四周期为四十九点零九，均处于五十附近的中性区域，显示多空力量完全均衡。MACD指标显示DIF线为负一点三四，DEA线为负一点五三，柱状图为正零点一八。虽然MACD仍在零轴下方运行，但柱状图已转正且持续扩大，暗示短期动能正在向多头倾斜。

布林带方面，上轨两千五百二十四美元，中轨两千五百零九美元，下轨两千四百九十四美元。带宽持续收窄至二十九美元左右，预示变盘在即。KDJ指标中K值为四十三点二三，D值为四十二点三三，J值为四十五点零三，三线在低位区域运行，尚未形成金叉，短期仍偏弱。

威廉指标显示负五十九点九八，处于中性偏弱区域。ATR指标为十五点九七，波动率较低。抛物线SAR指标位于两千五百三十一美元，远高于当前价格，构成明显的上方压力。

三、市场情绪分析

从消息面来看，以太坊面临的环境较为复杂。积极因素方面，Interactive Brokers正在推出原生ETH质押服务，为机构投资者提供了更便捷的参与方式。BitMine公司增持了一万二千五百三十二枚ETH，目标是控制约百分之五的流通供应量，企业层面的持续买入为价格提供了支撑。ETF资金流在十月十三日录得两千四百八十万美元净流入，结束了连续多日的流出态势。

然而风险因素同样不容忽视。此前以太坊现货ETF经历了连续十个交易日的净流出，累计赎回超过五亿七千七百万美元，显示机构情绪在前期明显恶化。虽然近期资金流有所改善，但整体流出规模仍然较大，需要持续的资金回流才能扭转颓势。

此外，宏观环境方面，美元走强和能源价格上涨继续压制风险资产偏好。Blur NFT平台宣布关闭前端，NFT市场成交量暴跌超过百分之九十九，反映出以太坊生态的部分领域正在经历深度调整。

综合来看，以太坊短期在两千五百美元关口展开拉锯战。技术指标显示多空力量均衡，MACD柱状图转正暗示短期动能偏多，但SAR和EMA九十九的压力仍然显著。若能放量突破两千五百二十美元布林带上轨，有望向两千六百美元挺进；若未能突破，可能回踩两千四百九十美元支撑。建议投资者密切关注ETF资金流向的变化以及宏观数据的指引。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What Matters More Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% of their time reviewing their own performance. They've got it backward.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (your rationale), what went right or wrong (execution), and
what you'll do differently next time (a specific action). Stick with it for a month, and you'll be amazed to discover that your losses...
Your trade log is full of the same kinds of mistakes repeated over and over—for example, always reversing your position right after a stop-loss,
or never holding on to winning trades.

The market changes, but your behavioral patterns won't change on their own unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don't just look at your account balance—go through your trading records.
